# Instructions for coding agents

Build a cinematic Russian-language professional portfolio for actor, director and screenwriter Vladimir Kisarov.

- Preserve original biographical and filmography facts; never invent credits, testimonials or contact details.
- Dark graphite, editorial typography, refined minimal motion; accessible responsive UI.
- Static output deployable on ordinary Russian hosting (REG.RU, Beget, Timeweb); no Vercel-only server features and no Lovable.
- Prefer local assets and self-hosted fonts; no critical media dependencies blocked in Russia.
- Keep actor and director work equally visible.
- Follow web-design-guidelines principles: accessible contrast, focus indicators, alt text, reduced-motion support, semantic landmarks, touch targets.
- Do not edit DNS or publish to vladimirkisarov.ru without explicit approval.
- Replace placeholders only with validated assets and links from the source site.
